title: dysoxylum arborescens
intro: Dysoxylum arborescens, commonly known as Philippine mahogany, is a species of plant native to the Philippines, belonging to the family Meliaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dysoxylum arborescens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
